summary.en-US: Console of the LedBox scoreboard, for the scorer's tablet

description.en-US:
Point Hub is the control screen of the LedBox scoreboard, made for the tablet at the scorer's table.

It finds the scoreboard by itself, on the board's own Wi-Fi or on the cable, also when that network has no internet, and shows the board's console: the game on the board, the link to an OpenVolley eScoresheet match, the history and the settings. The Game tab is drawn natively, for quick taps.

If the connection drops during a match, the console stays on screen and usable, and the scores reach the board once it is back. When nothing answers, its own screen helps to reconnect.

Kiosk mode keeps it fullscreen and in front. A hidden admin menu (PIN protected) has the Wi-Fi setup, the backups and the app updates.

It needs the scoreboard: on its own, the app only looks for one.
